faces.name: Neonate's Rush
faces.oracleText:
This spell costs {1} less to cast if you control a Vampire.
Neonate's Rush deals 1 damage to target creature and 1 damage to its controller. Draw a card.

faces.name: Neon Graveyard
faces.oracleText:
During your turn, for each color, you may cast a spell of that color from your graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. If you cast a permanent spell this way, it enters with a finality counter on it.
When chaos ensues, add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. Spend this mana only to cast spells from your graveyard.
